title: Field Promotion
caption: Field Promotion (V)
game_text: Deploy on your captain or commander. This character is an admiral and a leader. Imperials are immune to Demotion. Once per game, may ▲ a card with “Imperial” in title. {alter}
lore: Imperial officers are fiercely competitive, especially on the _Executor_. Lord Vader’s flagship is a place where devious political calculation prospers. The naive are doomed to failure.

notes: Non-unique (no dot on slip or printed card). Slip prints ▲ where the stub expands 'take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; red circle-slash A right after 'title.' → {alter}. The wiki's default 'Field Promotion' page carries Glossary Supplement wording; printed face = 'Field Promotion (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px Dagobah-D-fieldpromotion.gif is the PC Errata face — downloaded to src/vs5/37-Dagobah-D-fieldpromotion.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected from scan: 'Executor' italic, curly apostrophe in Vader’s. Copyright 1997 (Dagobah). Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px).
